turns.instruction:
Build the 2-story, 2-bay frame with 6 m spans and 3.6 m stories. Outer and middle columns have distinct sections; left and right beams are separate groups. All beams carry -Z 10 kN/m, right-story nodes +X 10/15 kN, and the connected first-story middle-column node at Z=1.8 m has -X 7 kN. Report global Ux and Uz at the highest-story rightmost beam-column joint, and global support moment My and vertical reaction Fz at the left base, for every listed case and combination.
Use the stated OpenSees engine for every computable changed state. First-order linear elastic analysis; self-weight, P-delta, rigid diaphragms, rigid offsets and construction stages are off. Preserve all fields not explicitly changed. Report every requested signed value with node/member, global direction, unit, case/combination, turn, model state and traceable . Rz denotes the vertical support reaction Fz. Retain original cases and evaluate every listed combination separately. Resolve essential missing or contradictory inputs before reporting new numerical results.
Revise B-right using the two attached property revisions. I have not specified which revision takes effect; report the revised result after resolving the revision.

Use v2 only for the two right-span beams b1-1 and b1-2. Keep left beams, both column groups, and all loads including -X 7 kN unchanged; recompute. Report global Ux and Uz at the highest-story rightmost beam-column joint, and global support moment My and vertical reaction Fz at the left base, for every listed case and combination.
